rows.note: Honest. Inference plus small declared fine-tunes.
rows.finding: No training run exceeded 50,000 GPU-hours; the largest declared job was 9,600 and all jobs together come to 24,000, consistent with grid energy and the verifier's own interconnect taps.

rows.note: Cheating. One run declared as six fine-tunes for six shell customers, all paid from the operator's parent.
rows.finding: One coordinated fine-tuning run on 1,100 GPUs across clusters A and B (days 22.0 to 28.3, about 166,000 GPU-hours) was split into six jobs billed to operator-controlled shell customers, each kept just under 50,000 GPU-hours.
